decisions.reason: As a single, more generic construction product with limited portfolio depth, its uncertainty should be largely resolved by 2022 and weak returns would not justify keeping the option open.
This multi-model niche lift line fits our core lifting and service capabilities, and the cost of keeping it on the market is likely modest relative to its remaining upside.
The building-material lift line is closely adjacent to our construction and handling strengths, so it still offers attractive option value with manageable ongoing commitment.

The truck-mounted furniture lift complements the broader lift offering and preserves access to a specialized segment, although its narrower scope makes it somewhat more exposed than the main lift lines.
